text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Acting Prime Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives message from Qatar's Foreign Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani.
- Ministry of Commerce and Industry is looking into 154 requests by investors to establish shareholder companies.
- Iran arrests members of three Iraqi spy cells.
- Demand on Gulf cement companies shares rises after announcement of mid-year results.

- Interior Ministry says no Islamist group kidnapping people over alleged violations of Islam's teachings. A Kuwaiti newspaper said on Monday an unknown Islamist group is flogging people in Kuwait for what it saw as violations to Islam.
- Unemployment threatens Kuwait's future. Officials say unemployment among Kuwaitis remains under one percent, but parliamentarians fear a sharp rise in unemployment figures by the end of the decade.
